project_type: TypeScript Node.js autonomous revenue agent for Solana blockchain
build_system: npm with TypeScript compiler (tsc). ESM modules (type: module). Node 24+ required.
test_framework: Vitest with inline env vars in vitest.config.ts. Tests in tests/ directory using temp SQLite DBs.
build_command: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 && npm run build
test_command: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 && npx vitest run
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compilation. 2. Run npx vitest run to verify all tests pass. 3. Verify Docker build with docker build -t only5:test .
environment_constraints: Node.js v24.15.0 available via nvm. npm registry accessible. Docker available.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode. ESM module resolution (NodeNext). SQLite via better-sqlite3 for persistence. Tests via Vitest.
key_patterns: - MemorySystem class in src/core/memory.ts uses better-sqlite3 with WAL mode. - Tests create temp DB in os.tmpdir() with randomUUID. - LLM integration via src/integrations/openrouter.ts (chat function). - Dependency injection pattern: classes accept deps objects (e.g., LearningSystem takes { llm, memory }). - Core modules exported from src/core/index.ts. - Types defined in src/types/index.ts. - Config via zod schema validation in src/config.ts.
directory_structure: src/core/ - Core agent modules (memory, learning, agent loop, risk, scheduler, etc). src/integrations/ - External service integrations (openrouter, solana, jupiter, github). src/strategies/ - Revenue strategy implementations. src/telegram/ - Telegram bot interface. src/types/ - TypeScript type definitions. tests/ - Mirrors src/ structure for tests.
